provenance.author: Mohammed Bangie
provenance.created_for: T24 evaluator hardening: interpretation correctness policy

components.exact_intent_match: predicted speech_act/intent equals gold_intent (or gold speech_act) exactly, no normalisation beyond that already applied to intent labels elsewhere

exact_cpc_frame_match.when_gold_selected_frame_id_present: compare the gold-selected candidate frame's material CPC fingerprint (systems.candidate_generation.material_cpc_fingerprint) to the predicted selected candidate frame's fingerprint; fall back to a plain frame_id equality check only when the frame content cannot be resolved from the available candidate_interpretations payloads on either side
exact_cpc_frame_match.when_gold_selected_frame_id_absent: compare the normalised filled-CPC slot maps (gold_cpc vs analysis.cpc) for exact equality under configs/evaluation/cpc_normalisation_v1.json

forbidden: intent_only_fallback: an intent match with a CPC/frame mismatch must never be reported as a correct interpretation
undetermined_policy: returns null/undetermined (excluded from denominators, exclusion_reason=missing_gold) when gold_intent is missing, or when gold supplies neither a gold_selected_frame_id nor a gold_cpc to compare against
notes: This policy is shared by the interpretation_correctness metric and the interpretation_route_decomposition four-way breakdown in evaluator.py.
Development-only; not valid for official use until frozen.
